evidence.quote: After electrochemical corrosion, it can be seen that the morphology of each alloy is a typical dendritic structure. With the increase of V content, the coarse secondary dendrites in the alloy become thinner and longer. The results show that the secondary dendrite spacing of V0.5, V1.0 and V1.5 alloys is 47.9 mm, 27.2 mm and 32.3 mm respectively
